title: 第23章 无人可挡第24章 绝世妖孽陈云轩
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第23章无人可挡！战斗中突破？
这小子果然是个妖孽！
寻常人战斗之时，都要全身心的投入到战斗之中，更何况是以一敌二的这种情况。
根本就不存在还有心思去想着修炼，或者提升自己的修为境界。
可陈云轩呢？不仅仅战斗不落下风，竟然还能够在关键时刻突破？
这简直是闻所未闻！见所未见！
“刘伯，这种情况，你见过吗？”程玉书皱着眉头问道。
“没见过。”
“要么这小子的功法有古怪，要么……他原本就可以突破到超凡境二重，只不过是一直在压制修为，没有突破。”
“我更倾向于他压制了修为境界。”刘伯表情严肃地说道。
压制了修为境界？
这倒是也有可能。
魏天风和武原两个人对视一眼，眼神之中满是忌惮和担忧。
超凡境一重的时候都如此难对付，突然陈云轩突破到了超凡境二重，岂不是更棘手？
陈云轩感受到修为突破之后，身体之中暴涨的力量，脸上出现了一抹微笑。
“老祖说的果然没错，战斗，才是提升实力最有效，最快捷的方式。”
陈云轩看向魏天风两人，淡淡的说道“这场战斗，应该结束了！”
“哼，小子，你少口出狂言！”
“真以为突破了一重之后，就能够碾压我们两人不成？”武原愤怒的说道。
“是真是假，一战便知！”
陈云轩并未多说废话，身影一闪，下一刻已经来到了魏天风的面前。
陈云轩的突然出现，让魏天风始料未及，还没有做出反应，陈云轩一拳，便已经将魏天风轰飞了出去。
一击之下，魏天风倒飞而出，口中更是喷出一口鲜血。
“卧槽！就突破了一下而已，实力变化怎么会这么大？”
“妈的，魏天风居然连一拳都扛不住？”
“这陈云轩是打算逆天吗？”
“什么叫打算？他已经逆天了。”
“可怕，好可怕的少年！”
魏天风被击飞，这让所有人都目瞪口呆，知道陈云轩妖孽，却不曾想，竟然已经妖孽到了如此地步。
武原第一个反应了过来，当下最想做的事情，就是逃离此处。
“想走？”
“你经过我允许了吗？”
武原刚打算转身逃走，却发现陈云轩不知道什么时候，已经出现在自己身后，挡住了退路。
输字还没有说出口，陈云轩又一次一拳挥出，让武原落得了一个和魏天风一样的下场。
静！
如天地被凝固了一般的安静！
谁都没有想到，最后的结果，居然是陈云轩大获全胜。
这个结果，别说其他人没有想到，程玉书和刘伯一样没想到。

Chapter 23 Unstoppable! Breakthrough in battle?
This guy is indeed a monster!
When ordinary people fight, they have to devote themselves wholeheartedly to the battle, let alone a situation like one against two.
There is simply no thought of practicing or improving one's own cultivation level.
But what about Chen Yunxuan? Not only did he not lose in the battle, but he was also able to break through at critical moments?
This is simply unheard of! Never seen before!
"Uncle Liu, have you ever seen this situation before?" Cheng Yushu asked with a frown.
"Never seen it."
"Either this kid's technique is weird, or... he could have broken through to the second level of the extraordinary realm, but he just kept suppressing his cultivation and failed to break through."
"I am more inclined to believe that he has suppressed his cultivation level." Uncle Liu said with a serious expression.
Suppressed the realm of cultivation?
This is indeed possible.
Wei Tianfeng and Wu Yuan looked at each other, their eyes full of fear and worry.
It was so difficult to deal with the first level of the Transcendent Realm. Suddenly Chen Yunxuan broke through to the second level of the Transcendent Realm. Wouldn't it be even more difficult?
Chen Yunxuan felt the surge of power in his body after his cultivation breakthrough, and a smile appeared on his face.
"The ancestor is indeed right. Fighting is the most effective and fastest way to improve your strength."
Chen Yunxuan looked at Wei Tianfeng and the two men and said calmly, "This battle should be over!"
"Hey, boy, stop talking nonsense!"
"Do you really think that after breaking through the first level, you can crush the two of us?" Wu Yuan said angrily.
"Whether it is true or not, we will find out in the first battle!"
Chen Yunxuan didn't say much nonsense. His figure flashed and the next moment he was in front of Wei Tianfeng.
Chen Yunxuan's sudden appearance caught Wei Tianfeng by surprise, and before he could react, Chen Yunxuan punched Wei Tianfeng away.
With one blow, Wei Tianfeng flew backwards, and a mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth.
"Damn it! It's just a breakthrough. How can the strength change so much?"
"Damn it, Wei Tianfeng can't even withstand a punch?"
"Is this Chen Yunxuan planning to defy heaven?"
"What do you mean by plan? He has gone against the grain."
"Terrible, what a scary boy!"
Wei Tianfeng was knocked away, which made everyone stunned. They knew that Chen Yunxuan was a monster, but they never thought that he had become such a monster.
Wu Yuan was the first to react. What he wanted to do most at the moment was to escape from here.
"Want to leave?"
"Did you ask my permission?"
Wu Yuan was just about to turn around and escape, but found that Chen Yunxuan had appeared behind him at some point, blocking his retreat.
"I admit..."
Before he could say defeat, Chen Yunxuan punched out again, causing Wu Yuan to end up with the same fate as Wei Tianfeng.
quiet!
It was as quiet as the world being frozen!
No one expected that the final result would be Chen Yunxuan's victory.
This result, not to mention that others did not expect it, Cheng Yushu and Liu Bo did not expect it.
